clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau ran a classified ad in the 1970s. It flopped - almost no replies, almost no orders.

A few weeks later he ran the exact same ad. He changed one word.

The mailman started showing up with a bag full of inquiries - before he could even get the last batch out of the mailbox. He had to call friends over just to help stuff envelopes on the kitchen table. Within days it was two mail bags, and the letters weren't just inquiries anymore - they were orders, with cash and money orders inside.

One word. That's the whole difference between an ad nobody answers and one that buries you in mail.
